description: A `return` in a top-level standalone `given @name :> { return }` guard has no function to leave: E-STMT-RETURN-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION (S462 review B2).
rationale: The guard's block runs in place at the top of the logic block; a `return` there would leave the client init function and skip the event wiring after it. §34 E-STMT-RETURN-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION.
